# Myntmore

> Myntmore is a Mumbai-based AI-powered B2B outbound agency that builds and runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach, and account-based marketing (ABM) systems for B2B companies, helping founders and sales teams book qualified meetings without hiring in-house SDRs.

## Company
- Founded: 2019, by Tejas Jhaveri
- Headquarters: Mumbai, India
- Website: https://www.myntmore.com

## Services
- [LinkedIn Outreach & Automation](https://www.myntmore.com/services/linkedin-outreach): Connection request and messaging sequences that turn LinkedIn into a meeting-booking channel.
- [Cold Email Infrastructure](https://www.myntmore.com/services/cold-email): Domain warm-up, deliverability infrastructure, and personalised cold email sequences for B2B outbound.
- [ICP Mapping & Lead Scoring](https://www.myntmore.com/services/sales-intelligence): Ideal customer profile research and buyer signal tracking.
- [AI Lead Generation](https://www.myntmore.com/services/ai-lead-generation): AI-driven prospecting, list building, and enrichment for B2B ICP targeting.
- [Account-Based Marketing](https://www.myntmore.com/services/account-based-marketing): Coordinated multi-channel campaigns targeting high-value accounts.
- [Personal Branding](https://www.myntmore.com/services/personal-branding): LinkedIn thought leadership and profile positioning for founders and execs.
- [GTM Strategy](https://www.myntmore.com/services/gtm-strategy): ICP, positioning, and channel mix strategy, built and executed by the same team across the other six services.

## Who this is for
- [Who Myntmore Is For (and Who It Isn't)](https://www.myntmore.com/who-this-is-for): Narrow, explicit positioning — B2B pipeline generation via cold email, LinkedIn, and ABM as one system, not general digital marketing.
- [How to Choose a B2B Outbound Agency](https://www.myntmore.com/how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency): A neutral evaluation checklist for vetting any outbound agency, not just Myntmore.
- [Agency vs. In-House SDR](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/agency-vs-in-house): A balanced comparison of building outbound in-house vs. hiring an agency.

## Resources
- [Case Studies](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies): Client results and campaign breakdowns.
- [Blog](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs): Outbound strategy and B2B growth content.
- [Guides](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides): Playbooks on cold email, LinkedIn, and ABM.
- [The Do's and Don'ts of Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/dos-and-donts-of-outreach): Pattern interruption in outbound, channel-specific tips for LinkedIn and cold email, what data enrichment is, and Myntmore's free outreach tools.
- [Glossary](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary): Definitions of Myntmore's own frameworks (Total Conversional Market, Signal-Heavy Structuring, the 3-Second Rule).
- [2026 B2B Outbound Benchmark Report](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/b2b-outbound-benchmark-report-2026): Reply rate, inbox placement, and time-to-meeting benchmarks aggregated across managed accounts.
